environment_settings.mount_strategy: private mount namespace (unshare + tmpfs) around the fixture process

observations.scope: Synthetic POSIX/Linux file operations by dropped-privilege child processes. No native coding agent, model, native logging, native session resume or built-in edit route was run. Legitimate-operation controls are synthetic proxies.

verdict_definitions.effect_observed: Child reported success and the independent before/after snapshots show the operation's defined effect.
verdict_definitions.permission_denial_observed: Child failed with EACCES or EPERM and the protected state (transcript snapshot, records directory metadata and listing, parent listing, locations of the original inode) is identical before and after.
verdict_definitions.different_effect_observed: Child reported success and state changed, but not in the way the operation's effect is defined; the concrete outcome is recorded.
verdict_definitions.not_run: Not executed: not applicable to the layout, or the environment lacks a required feature (reason recorded).
verdict_definitions.unexpected_error: Anything else: wrong child identity or descriptor state, fixture base unreachable, other errno, partial change together with a reported error, or reported success without a change.

rewrite.effect_definition: same inode; content equals the replacement record

overwrite_in_place.effect_definition: same inode; leading bytes replaced by pwrite at offset 0, length unchanged

append_marker.effect_definition: same inode; content equals original record plus fabricated marker

delete.effect_definition: transcript path absent and no other name in the fixture refers to the original inode

replace.effect_definition: transcript path is a regular file with a different inode, owned by the agent, holding the replacement record

chmod_then_rewrite.effect_definition: same inode; content equals the replacement record (after chmod 0666)

chown_to_agent.effect_definition: transcript owner and group changed to the agent account

rename_within_dir.effect_definition: transcript path absent; records/moved.jsonl is the original inode

rename_out_of_dir.effect_definition: transcript path absent; workspace/moved.jsonl is the original inode

rename_parent_dir.effect_definition: records directory path absent; the original inode is now under home/records-moved

hardlink_create.effect_definition: workspace/hardlink.jsonl is the original inode; link count +1; transcript content unchanged (a second name, not a modification)

symlink_swap_file.effect_definition: lstat of the transcript path is a symlink and reading the path yields agent-controlled content

symlink_swap_dir.effect_definition: lstat of the records directory path is a symlink and reading the transcript path yields agent-controlled content; original inode under home/records-moved

create_sibling.effect_definition: records/sibling.jsonl exists, owned by the agent; transcript unchanged

clear_inode_flags_then_rewrite.effect_definition: append-only/immutable flags cleared and content equals the replacement record

agent_workspace_edit_and_test.description: Agent creates a module and a unittest in the workspace, sees it fail, edits the module, sees it pass.

recorder_append.description: Recorder opens the existing transcript O_WRONLY|O_APPEND and writes one record.

recorder_new_transcript.description: Recorder creates a new file in the records directory with O_CREAT|O_EXCL (new-session proxy).

recorder_read_back.description: Recorder reads the transcript back and the hash matches (resume proxy).

agent_read_transcript.description: Whether the agent account can read the transcript. Recorded, not judged.

precreate_next_session_name.description: Agent creates records/next-session.jsonl (a predictable next transcript name) first. The recorder then tries O_CREAT|O_EXCL on that name, then O_CREAT|O_APPEND without O_EXCL, then the agent tries to rewrite whatever file holds that name. Suppression = the agent's file holds the name and the recorder's exclusive create fails with EEXIST.

fill_filesystem_then_recorder_append.description: Records tree and workspace on ONE small size-limited tmpfs. Agent writes fill.bin in the workspace, the parent of the records directory and the records directory until ENOSPC. The recorder then appends records to the existing transcript. Suppression = the recorder hits ENOSPC before all records are written.

fill_filesystem_then_recorder_append_sep.description: Same, but the records tree and the workspace are on two SEPARATE small tmpfs filesystems; the agent still tries every sink it can reach.

agent_owned_writable.description: Agent-owned file, directory and parent (current same-account wrapper baseline).

recorder_file_agent_writable_dir.description: Recorder-owned file in an agent-owned directory.

sticky_1777_dir_recorder_file.description: Recorder-owned file in a recorder-owned world-writable sticky directory.

sticky_1770_shared_group_dir.description: Recorder-owned file in a sticky directory writable by a group shared with the agent.

setgid_2770_shared_group_file_0640.description: Setgid shared-group directory (no sticky bit); file group-readable only.

setgid_2770_shared_group_file_0660.description: Setgid shared-group directory (no sticky bit); file group-writable.

recorder_owned_agent_readonly.description: Recorder-owned file and directory; agent has read/search access only (0755/0644).

recorder_owned_no_agent_access.description: Recorder-owned file and directory; agent has no access (0700/0600).

recorder_dir_in_agent_owned_parent.description: Recorder-owned file and directory (0755/0644) whose parent directory is agent-owned.

append_only_same_account.description: Agent-owned file with the append-only inode flag; recorder and agent share one account.

append_only_file_and_dir_same_account.description: Agent-owned file and directory both append-only; recorder and agent share one account.

append_only_recorder_owned.description: Recorder-owned file and directory (0755/0644); file append-only.

immutable_recorder_owned.description: Recorder-owned file and directory (0755/0644); file immutable.

acl_agent_read_only.description: Recorder-owned 0700/0600 plus POSIX ACL giving the agent r-x on the directory and r-- on the file.

acl_agent_dir_write_file_read.description: Recorder-owned 0700/0600 plus POSIX ACL giving the agent rwx on the directory and r-- on the file.
